technical_quality: Adequate inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), mediastinum roughly centred with no significant rotation, good penetration (spine visible through the heart). Scapulae not fully rotated out and overlap the lateral upper/mid lung fields; bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones. Slightly soft/blurred image quality.

devices.type: External radiographic marker (white L-shaped / laterality marker)
devices.location: Image upper right = patient's left shoulder, lateral to the left humeral head

abnormalities.finding: Mild perihilar vascular prominence with slight haziness (possible mild interstitial edema); no Kerley B lines, no pleural effusion, heart size normal - equivocal
Gas-filled colon (splenic flexure) with haustral markings and gastric bubble beneath the left hemidiaphragm - likely normal bowel gas, no free air
Bilateral breast shadows overlying the lower lung zones (soft-tissue overlap, not lung pathology)
Scapulae projected over the lateral lung fields (positioning)

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光，吸氣尚可，縱膈居中，氣管居中，心臟大小正常，肋膈角兩側銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。雙側肺門血管紋理略增粗且周圍稍呈模糊，右側肺門較明顯，但周邊肺野透亮、未見明確 Kerley B 線或肺泡性浸潤，僅為輕微且不確定之肺水腫徵象。左側橫膈下可見含氣之結腸（脾曲）及胃泡，雙側乳影重疊於下肺野，肩胛骨部分重疊於外側肺野。影像右上角（病人左肩處）見一 L 形外部標記；未見胸管、導管、節律器或其他置入物。
